project.name: osgi/exchange/exchange-port
project.description: The world-exchange seam: the neutral Document envelope (domain, coordinate, String payload) every host↔OSGi crossing carries, the ExchangeCatalog of coordinate + field names, and the ReadinessAuthority verb the host calls to turn a checkpoint outcome into a provisioning verdict. type=seam: system-exported, one shared copy across the boundary, like every -port. The payload is a serialized JSON String, never a jackson JsonNode — a seam references only flat (JDK) types, so it carries NO third-party dependency; each world parses with its own jackson.
